question: Whence truth-discourse while the senses remain restless?
premises: Truth-discourse is questioned during that duration.
The correlative links duration to discourse.
inference: Restless senses obstruct or delay truth-discourse.
uncertainties: Whether tattvakathā is subject or object in the rhetorical question.
plain_english: As long as there is restlessness of the senses, so long, whence is discourse on truth?
